description: Several colorful microfiber cloths and a small yellow ball are spread across the tabletop, with an open cardboard box sitting near the back. The left hand slides and gathers the cloths into a pile near the center while the right hand pulls another cloth in from the right; then the right hand flicks the yellow ball into the box, and both hands repeatedly pick up cloths (pink, blue, green, yellow) and toss them into the cardboard box, releasing each one after it lands.
